ContactNumber = data.ContactNumber --- if(data != null and AreaCode != null and ContactNumber != null) (AreaCode ++ "-" ++ ContactNumber) else if(data !=null and AreaCode != null and ContactNumber == null) AreaCode else if(data !=null and AreaCode == null and ContactNumber != null) ContactNumber else "#N/A" } --- (vars.contactsdata default [] map ((item, index) -> { "FirstName": item.FirstName default null, "LastName": item.LastName default null, "Suffix": item.Suffix default "#N/A", "Email": if ( (p('api.env') == "PROD")) (lower((item.Emails filter($.EmailAddressTypeCode == "BRDEMAIL")).EmailAddress[0])) else (lower((item.Emails filter($.EmailAddressTypeCode == "BRDEMAIL")).EmailAddress[0]) ++ ".invalid"), "Phone": getPhone((item.Phones filter($.TelecommunicationsNumberTypeCode == "WORK" and $.Type == "Landline"))[0]), "Employee_ID__c": item.EmpId, "MailingStreet": createString([item.Location.Address1,item.Location.Address2,item.Location.Address3,item.Location.Address4]) default "#N/A", "MailingCity": item.Location.CityName default "#N/A", "MailingPostalCode": item.Location.PostalCode default "#N/A", "MailingState": item.Location.StateAbbreviation default "#N/A", "MailingCountry": item.Location.CountryCode default "#N/A", "Title": item.ProfessionalTitleName default "#N/A", "Officer_Title__c": Mule::p('officerType'++"."++ (item.OfficerTitleCode)) default "#N/A", "Preferred_Name__c": createString([item.PreferredLastName,item.PreferredFirstName,item.PreferredMiddleName]) default "#N/A", "RecordTypeId": vars.recordTypeId.Id[0] default null, "User__c": empMappedIds[item.EmpId][0] default "#N/A", "Manager__c": do{ var userData = (vars.userEmployeeNumbers filter($.EmployeeNumber == item.JobPositionDetail.SupervisorEmpId))[0] --- if ( (userData != null) and (userData.IsActive == "true"))(empMappedIds[item.JobPositionDetail.SupervisorEmpId][0]) else "#N/A" }, "GL_Code__c": item.EmployeeCostCenter default "#N/A", "Active__c": item.EmploymentDetail.Active default null, "Ethnic_Group__c": item.PersonalDetail.EthnicGroupName default "#N/A", "Gender__c": item.PersonalDetail.GenderCode default "#N/A", "Address_Floor__c": item.Location.Floor default "#N/A", "Department_Name__c": item.Department.Name default "#N/A", "OwnerId": do{ var userData = (vars.userEmployeeNumbers filter($.EmployeeNumber == item.EmpId))[0] --- if ( (userData != null) and
